name: M7.Connectivity.difference_shift
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : Finset (ZMod N)) (s : ZMod N), M7.Connectivity.differences (M7.Domain.shift A s) = M7.Connectivity.differences A
guidance: Extensionality and literal finite image membership. The two translations cancel in differences. Both directions, including empty A. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
